title: Classic French Croque Monsieur with Gruyère Béchamel (The Vivaldi Way)
originalTitle: Classic French Croque Monsieur with Gruyère Béchamel (The Vivaldi Way)
ingredients: Salt, pepper, and nutmeg to taste
2 slices of a nice thick cut bread
instructions: Melt butter in a pan, whisk in flour, and cook briefly to remove the raw flour taste.
Add milk and stir until the mixture thickens into a
Remove from heat and stir in salt, pepper, nutmeg, and a portion of the grated Gruyère cheese.
Spread Dijon mustard on one side of the bread slices.
Assemble the sandwich with the béchamel sauce and ham.
Toast the sandwich in a frying pan with butter until golden brown on both sides.
Spread additional béchamel sauce and sprinkle more Gruyère on top of the sandwich.
Place in a 400°F oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly, or use the broiler to speed up the process
